key: A both orders give the same unpaired count
correct_answer: a Both filling orders give the same number of unpaired electrons in Fe²⁺
reason: Printed 'Which statements are true?' but single-correct; (c) is the only tempting distractor (3d⁸ of neutral Fe has more pairing, but that pairing is Pauli-required, not 'unnecessary', and Fe²⁺ is 3d⁶ either way).
work: correct: 4s²3d⁶ → Fe²⁺ 3d⁶ (4 unpaired); incorrect: 3d⁸ → Fe²⁺ 3d⁶ (4 unpaired) → same
